items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: And we became very good friends from that time on.

ctx.x: Buddy Charles is a stepson of Muggsy Spanier. And I’ve heard about him from Muggsy. I knew Muggsy pretty well and he used to talk about Buddy. And one time in the Chicago, at a meeting in Chicago, another doctor and I had a room and he said one night he said “before I go to bed let’s go out and have a nightcap.” And the back door of the Drake is on Oak Street, right across from Shanango, about half way up the block is a place called the Acorn on Oak. It’s on Oak Street. So we went up there to have one drink. We…
All right. The Buddy Charles sandwich.
